title: Spotted With Simbu Years Ago - Today He Is The Director Of A Rs 650 Crore Hit!
text: Vallavan remains one of the most memorable films in Tamil actor Silambarasan, aka Simbu’s, career. Directed by Simbu himself, the film struck a chord with young audiences when it was released in 2006. Interestingly, a now well-known name in Tamil cinema was associated with this film, and many believe he may have worked as an assistant director on Vallavan. That person is none other than Nelson Dilipkumar, currently one of the most sought-after directors in Tamil cinema. Nelson first grabbed the attention of Tamil audiences with Kolamaavu Kokila, and following the success of his debut, he went on to direct Doctor, which was also warmly received. With consecutive hits to his credit, Nelson rose rapidly in popularity and soon got the opportunity to collaborate with actor Vijay on Beast. Although Beast received mixed reviews and did not meet expectations, Nelson made a strong comeback after a brief break with Jailer, starring Rajinikanth. Jailer emerged as a massive success and re-established his standing as a leading director. Released worldwide, Jailer reportedly collected over Rs 650 crore, setting new benchmarks and becoming the second highest-grossing Tamil film of all time. Now, for the high-budget sequel Jailer 2, reports suggest that Nelson is being offered a remuneration of Rs 60 crore. Despite his current stature, Nelson’s journey began humbly as an assistant scriptwriter at Star Vijay TV. He initially worked as an assistant director on several television shows before becoming part of the core creative and production teams behind popular Star Vijay programmes such as Jodi Number 1, Airtel Super Singer, and Bigg Boss Tamil. It was during Jodi Number 1 that Nelson became acquainted with Simbu, who was serving as a judge on the show. This association continued during Vallavan, though their friendship did not last indefinitely. In 2010, Simbu launched Vettai Mannan, through which Nelson was set to make his directorial debut. Portions of the film were completed, and the teaser generated considerable excitement within the Tamil film industry. However, due to various reasons, the project was eventually shelved midway. Forced to restart his career from scratch, Nelson returned to Vijay TV before re-entering cinema with Kolamaavu Kokila, which marked a turning point in his journey. Today, in an interesting full-circle moment, Nelson has appeared on screen alongside Simbu as an actor. A special scene from the film Arasan, featuring both Nelson and Simbu, was recently released and has gone viral on social media.
